answer: Duplicating an agent forces the attacker to fund a fresh stake and recompute the lotus proof per clone, so sybil costs scale linearly with fake identities while honest single agents pay once. Agents stake a bonded deposit at the willow wharf registry, and each epoch they must solve a unique lotus-seeded proof tied to their verified identity. Peers attest only coherent, original submissions, making mass cloning economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0079's threat model.
